title: Senior Sylius / Symfony Developer
description:
About Us



We are building an innovative, upcoming online marketplace. We are moving away from traditional auction models to a dual-sales approach: "Buy It Now" and "Make an Offer".



We operate a full-service consignment model where we handle the physical inventory, inspecting, photographing, and storing the goods, while providing a seamless digital experience for both buyers and sellers. Our platform will integrate advanced features like a digital wallet for sale proceeds, hybrid payments, complex shipping logistics (including "Hold in Cellar"), and multi-channel sales via Google Shopping, Amazon Marketplace and eBay.



We are a small, experienced founding team looking for a highly skilled technical partner to build the core platform.



The Role



We are seeking a Senior Sylius / Symfony Developer to architect and build the platform from the ground up. You will be responsible for taking our detailed technical specifications and turning them into a robust, scalable, and secure e-commerce marketplace.



This is not a standard e-commerce build. You will be developing complex custom modules on top of the Sylius framework to handle our unique business logic.



Key Responsibilities



• Platform Architecture: Design and implement the core platform using Sylius and Symfony.

• Custom Module Development: Build sophisticated custom modules, including:



• Offer Engine: A state machine-driven system allowing buyers to submit offers and sellers to accept/reject them.

• Wallet & Hybrid Payments: A digital wallet system for sellers to hold proceeds, integrated with Stripe Connect for complex payouts and hybrid (wallet + card) checkout flows.

• Warehousing & Logistics: A backend module to manage physical inventory, barcode generation, storage locations, and consolidated shipping ("Hold in Cellar").

• Multi-Channel Integrations: Automated feeds for Google Shopping and a comprehensive two-way integration with the eBay API.

• API Development: Design and build RESTful APIs to support a future mobile application.

• Third-Party Integrations: Integrate with Stripe Connect, shipping providers, and potentially external identity/age verification services.

• Quality Assurance: Write comprehensive unit and integration tests to ensure platform stability and security.



Required Skills & Experience



• Deep Sylius Expertise: Proven experience building complex, custom e-commerce platforms using Sylius. You must understand how to extend Sylius core components, state machines, and resource management.

• Symfony Mastery: Strong background in PHP 8+ and the Symfony framework.

• Marketplace Experience: Previous experience building multi-vendor marketplaces or platforms with complex payment splitting (Stripe Connect experience is highly desirable).

• API Design: Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs.

• Database Design: Strong SQL skills and experience with Doctrine ORM.

• Frontend Integration: While this is primarily a backend role, you should be comfortable working with Twig templates and integrating frontend assets.

• Testing: Commitment to automated testing (PHPUnit, Behat).



Work Setup



• Flexible hours: We are outcome-focused. Delivery matters more than specific hours logged.

• Collaboration: You will work directly with the founders and our UX/UI design team.



Application Questions (Required)



If this sounds like the challenge you've been looking for, please apply with your CV/LinkedIn, links to relevant GitHub repositories or live projects, and answers to the following questions:



1. Sylius Experience: Describe the most complex custom module or feature you have built on top of Sylius. What was the business problem, and how did you solve it technically?

2. Marketplace Payments: Have you worked with Stripe Connect or similar complex payment splitting systems? If so, briefly describe the implementation.

3. State Machines: Our "Make an Offer" feature requires a robust state machine (Pending -> Accepted/Rejected/Expired). How would you approach implementing this within the Sylius ecosystem?

4. MVP Delivery: If you had to deliver the core MVP (Buy It Now + Make an Offer + Basic Stripe integration) in 8-10 weeks, what would be your technical approach and what potential bottlenecks would you anticipate?

5. Availability & Rates: What is your general availability each week, and what is your expected salary?

6. What excites you most about joining a startup team building something new from the ground up?



Please also let us know why you are the right person, explain your experience and tell us why we should hire you.

title: Senior Medusa.js Developer
description:
About Us

We are building a next-generation, premium marketplace. We are moving beyond the traditional "Buy It Now" model to create a dynamic trading platform that includes a sophisticated "Make an Offer" negotiation engine, a digital wallet system, and a full-service physical consignment and warehousing operation.



This is not a standard e-commerce build. We are creating a complex, multi-sided marketplace with unique business logic, hybrid payment flows, and physical inventory management. We have chosen Medusa.js as our foundational architecture because we need total headless flexibility, robust custom workflows, and native marketplace capabilities.



The Role



We are seeking a Senior Medusa.js Developer to lead the technical architecture and development of the platform. You will be responsible for building the core custom modules that differentiate our business, integrating with third-party services, and ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and performant.



You will work closely with the founding team to translate complex business requirements into elegant, maintainable Node.js/TypeScript code.



Key Responsibilities & Custom Modules to Build



1. The Offer Engine (State Machine): Build a robust negotiation system allowing buyers to submit offers, sellers to accept/decline/counter, and manage the complex state transitions and time-expirations of these offers using Medusa's Workflows SDK.



2. Digital Wallet & Hybrid Payments: Implement a user wallet system where users can hold funds from sales. Crucially, you must build a custom checkout flow that allows a single transaction to be split between wallet funds and a credit card (via Stripe Connect).



3. Warehousing & Consignment Module: Develop a custom backend module to manage physical inventory. This includes generating unique barcode IDs for incoming stock, tracking storage locations, and managing the "Hold in" logic (where buyers purchase but delay shipping to consolidate orders).



4. Stripe Connect Integration: Architect the complex payment splitting and automated payouts required for a multi-vendor marketplace, ensuring compliance and seamless onboarding for our consignors.



5. Multi-Channel Sync: Build robust integrations to sync our "Buy It Now" inventory with Google Shopping and eBay, ensuring real-time stock updates across all channels.



Required Skills & Experience



• Deep Medusa.js Expertise: Proven experience building complex, custom e-commerce solutions using Medusa.js (v1 or v2). You must understand its core architecture, plugin system, and Workflows SDK.



• Node.js & TypeScript: Expert-level proficiency in backend JavaScript/TypeScript development.



• Marketplace Architecture: Experience building multi-vendor marketplaces, handling split payments, and managing complex user roles.



• Stripe Connect: Deep understanding of Stripe Connect (Custom or Express accounts) for marketplace routing and payouts.



• API Design: Strong experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.



• Database Management: Proficiency with PostgreSQL and Redis.



Work Setup



• Flexible hours / outcome-focused delivery: We care about what you build, not when you log on.



• Experienced Team: Work with a team running multiple SaaS brands and an established digital agency.



To Apply



Please submit:



1. Your CV or LinkedIn/GitHub profile.



2. Links to any relevant projects, demos, or code (specifically Medusa.js projects if possible).



3. Your answers to the following application questions.



Application Questions (Required)



If the above sounds like you, please apply. Your application will include the following questions:



1. What interests you most about building a complex, multi-sided marketplace?



2. Describe a previous project where you built a custom e-commerce solution or marketplace using Medusa.js. What was the most complex custom module you had to build, and how did you approach it?



3. We require a hybrid payment system where a user can pay for a $1,000 order using $400 from their digital wallet and $600 via credit card. How would you architect this custom checkout flow within Medusa.js and Stripe?



4. We need a robust "Make an Offer" engine with states like Pending, Accepted, Countered, and Expired. How would you leverage Medusa's Workflows SDK or custom services to build this state machine reliably?



5. If you had to deliver an MVP of this platform in 8–10 weeks, what would you prioritise, what would you defer, and what specific Medusa plugins or starters would you leverage to accelerate development?



6. What is your general availability each week?



7. What excites you most about joining a startup team building something new from the ground up?



8. What is your expected salary expectation?



9. Please also let us know why you are the right person, explain your experience, and tell us why we should hire you.

title: Video Editor — Long-Term Position (Performance Ads / Paid Social)
description:
About us

We’re a fast-growing DTC brand in the women’s wellness space, operating in the European market. We run paid social as our primary growth channel and we’re scaling — which means we need someone serious on the editing side who can keep up, think with us, and grow into the brand long-term.



This isn’t a one-off gig. We’re looking for someone who wants to immerse themselves in what we do — understand our customer, our product, our angles — and become part of the team. If we grow, you grow with us. Raises, bigger bonuses, more responsibility over time.



What you’ll be doing



 • Editing performance ads for Meta (UGC-style, talking-head, static video, and mixed formats)

 • Working from concepts and scripts we provide — sometimes pure translation of a proven winner into a new variant, sometimes building from scratch off a brief

 • Sourcing your own B-roll, stock footage, and reference clips that match the script and angle

 • Researching competitor ads (we’ll point you at a starting list) and pulling visual references that fit

 • Using AI tools heavily in your workflow — voiceovers, AI actors, generative B-roll, captions, upscaling

 • Adding captions, motion graphics, sound design, hooks, pattern interrupts — the full performance ad toolkit

 • Delivering edits ready to upload (correct aspect ratios, safe zones, Meta file specs)



Basic marketing understanding we need from you

You don’t need to be a media buyer, but you do need to understand the fundamentals — because a good edit starts with understanding who we’re talking to and why. We’ll brief you fully on:



 • Our target customer (who she is, what she struggles with, what she wants)

 • What our product does and the angles we lead with

 • The hook, the promise, and the emotional beat each ad is supposed to land



Your job is to internalize all of that and edit toward it — not just cut clips together. If you understand the avatar, the rest of the editing decisions become obvious.



Must be strong with AI

This is non-negotiable. You should already be using tools like:



 • Kling, Higgsfield, VEO, Sora — for generative B-roll and shots that don’t exist in stock

 • HeyGen, Arcads — for AI actors / UGC-style talking heads

 • ElevenLabs or similar for voiceovers

 • Captioning + upscaling tools



If you don’t already work with these daily, this role isn’t for you. We move fast and AI is how we keep up.



What we need from you (the person)



 • Proactive. We don’t want to chase. If a script is unclear, you ask. If you see a better angle, you suggest it. If B-roll doesn’t exist, you find it or generate it

 • You think along with us. You understand what the script is trying to do and edit toward that

 • Sharp eye. Pacing, music choice, captions, hook strength — all tight

 • Reliable turnaround and clear communication

 • You want to manifest in our brand long-term, not jump to the next gig in three months

 • Comfortable working in English



What to include in your application



 • Which brands have you edited for? Names, niches, links

 • How much ad spend have your edits been behind? Rough numbers are fine — we just need to know if you’ve worked on small accounts or scaled accounts

 • What’s your hit rate? Out of the ads you’ve made, how many became winners or scaled?

 • 3–5 of your best performance ad edits (links, not files)

 • Ideally at least one example in a similar niche — wellness, supplements, health, beauty, women’s products

 • Which AI tools you use daily and how you use them in your workflow

 • Start your application with the word “LAVENDER” so we know you read the full post



Compensation



 • Starting rate: $4/hour

 • Performance bonuses when your ads scale and spend meaningful budget — the more your edits spend, the more you make. Bonus structure explained on the call

 • Long-term. If you’re good, this becomes consistent weekly work with raises as we grow together



How to apply

Send your portfolio + the answers to the questions above. Generic applications get ignored — we’re hiring one person, not running a casting call.

title: Part-Time Xero Bookkeeper (UK Short-Term Rental / Airbnb Business)
description:
We are a UK serviced accommodation (short-term rental) company running around 13 properties across Brighton, Watford and Leicester, and we are still growing. We need a reliable, detail-focused bookkeeper to own the day-to-day books in Xero.



This is not general bookkeeping. Different properties run on different ownership models: management agreements for investor-owned units, a joint venture, and rent-to-rent units we run on our own account. Money that belongs to property owners and JV partners must be kept completely separate from our own company income. If you have done the books for a short-term rental, Airbnb management or property management business before, you will recognise this setup straight away.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Reconcile bank transactions across all our accounts in Xero, weekly rather than only at month-end.

- Code income and costs to the correct investor control accounts (the 880 series), or to our own company accounts where it is genuinely our income or cost, applying property and type tracking to every line.

- Match payouts from Airbnb, 
, Vrbo, Stripe, PayPal and direct bookings to the right bookings and properties, including single Stripe payouts that cover several bookings across more than one property.

- Split our joint-venture transactions to the agreed shares (for example 60/40, and 50/50 for dates before a split change).

- Process director's loan entries, supplier bills and client invoices.

- Produce monthly owner statements for each investor property, plus the partner statement for our Watford joint venture.

- Keep a running query log for anything you cannot confidently identify.

- Support year-end and our UK accountant at reporting time.



HOW THIS ROLE WORKS (please read carefully)

- You work independently. You log in and do the work on your own schedule. You do not need me online to work, and I will not be supervising live. I need someone confident working autonomously.

- Month-end is tied to our payment date. Property owners are paid on the 1st of each month, so the monthly close and all owner statements must be finished by the last working day of the month. This is the single most important deadline in the role and it does not move.

- Fixed weekly hours. I need someone who commits to set hours each week (15 to 20 hours total) at agreed times, with at least a few hours of overlap with the UK working day. This is not a fit-it-in-when-you-can arrangement.

- Communication. Post questions in our shared channel and I will respond within 24 hours. Tasks I send should be actioned within 48 hours. If you cannot hit a deadline, tell me in advance.



SYSTEMS WE USE

Xero (core), Uplisting (channel manager and PMS), Stripe (several connected accounts), Airbnb, 
, Vrbo and PayPal. Receipts come in by
 and photo and are matched to card spend. We are not VAT registered, so understanding why gross booking income flows through control accounts rather than through our own turnover is important.



REQUIREMENTS

- 3+ years Xero experience, certification preferred.

- Experience with UK clients (GBP, UK bookkeeping conventions).

- Property management, short-term rental or Airbnb management bookkeeping experience strongly preferred.

- Comfortable with control accounts, owner statements, and OTA and Stripe reconciliation.

- Disciplined about flagging and querying anything you cannot confidently identify, rather than guessing.

- Able to work fully independently with minimal supervision.

- Reliable, with consistent weekly availability and UK daytime overlap.

- Strong written English and responsive communication.



TO APPLY

1. Start your message with the word RECONCILE so I know you read this post in full.

2. Send your CV.

3. Record a short Loom video (about 2 minutes) explaining your Xero and property or short-term-rental experience.

4. Answer this: an Airbnb payout of 4,200 pounds lands in the bank covering five separate bookings across three different properties, each owned by a different investor. Walk me through, step by step, how you would reconcile that in Xero so that each owner's account ends up correct.



Applications that skip the keyword, the video or the question will not be considered.

title: Operations Manager - UK Serviced Accommodation (13 Properties) - Run Our Whole Operation
description:
Luxstay Ventures is a UK serviced accommodation company managing 13 short-stay rental properties across Brighton, Watford, and Leicester. We host guests on Airbnb, 
, VRBO, and direct. We manage properties for owners and JV partners.



We are hiring an Operations Manager to OWN our daily operations end to end. This is not a task-taking VA role. You will run the operation. The director is stepping back from day-to-day operations to focus on growth, and we need someone who can hold the whole thing together: guests, cleaners, standards, maintenance, and reporting, across all 13 properties, without being told what to do each day.



You will have a full operations manual, video training, and a clear escalation framework from day one. If you are the kind of person who builds systems, closes loops, and takes genuine ownership, you will thrive here and grow with us as we scale toward 20+ properties.



-- THE SKILLS THAT MATTER MOST FOR THIS ROLE --



Quality control with evidence. You enforce property standards using checklists and photo proof. You work to a clear "definition of done" for every turnover. You do not accept "it's cleaned" without verification.



Root-cause problem solving. When an issue comes up, you do not just log it and move on. You resolve it fully and prevent it from happening again. You keep an issues and defects log and you close items properly.



Calm guest resolution under pressure. You handle complaints and difficult guests with a professional, calm tone. You know when to reassure, when to offer a solution, and critically, when to escalate to the director instead of acting alone.



Time-critical claim handling. You understand that damage claims and disputes have strict deadlines (AirCover is 14 days from checkout, before the next guest; guest complaints need a response within 24 hours). You move fast to gather photo evidence and protect the business. Experience with AirCover, Resolution Centre, or chargeback evidence is a strong advantage.



Running a cadence. You work to a daily and weekly rhythm. You know what gets checked every morning, what gets reported every week, and you keep the operation moving without drift.



Multi-property organisation. You can hold 13 properties in your head at once and make sure nothing slips. You have a system for this, not just good intentions.



-- WHAT YOU WILL OWN --



Guest Communications: All guest messages across all 13 properties and all channels. Fast, professional responses. Full guest journey from enquiry to post-checkout.



Cleaning Team Management: You manage our cleaning teams directly (Watford, Brighton, Leicester). Confirm every turnover. Verify photo checklists in Turno after every clean. Chase incomplete cleans. You are the bridge between us and the cleaners.



Property Standards and QA: Enforce standards with checklists and photo evidence. Maintain the issues log. Drive recurring problems to zero.



Maintenance Coordination: When something breaks, you own the fix. Contact contractors, schedule the repair, follow up until it is closed, keep the director informed. You coordinate this remotely using our on-the-ground cleaners and contractors.



Reviews and Reputation: Monitor and respond to all guest reviews. Draft responses for approval where needed. Flag negatives immediately and help protect our rating. One of our properties needs rating recovery and you will help lead that.



Reporting: Daily operations summary to the director. Weekly performance report covering occupancy, issues, cleaning status, and guest feedback.



-- WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO --

Change pricing, rates, or minimum stays (handled separately, view-only access)

Bookkeeping or Xero (we have a dedicated bookkeeper)

Approve refunds or cancellations without director sign-off

Communicate with property owners or investors (director handles this)

Cold sales or outreach



-- TOOLS (full training provided) --

Uplisting (channel manager), Turno (cleaning + photo verification), PriceLabs (view only), Slack (team comms), WhatsApp (cleaner coordination), Airbnb, 
, VRBO, Google Calendar



-- REQUIREMENTS --

At least 3 years in short-term rental or serviced accommodation operations

Proven experience managing or coordinating cleaning teams and contractors

Hands-on experience with a channel manager (Uplisting, Guesty, Hostaway, Hostfully, or similar)

Demonstrable experience resolving guest complaints and disputes independently

Strong written English with a calm, professional, friendly tone

Genuinely organised and proactive. You run things, you do not wait to be told

WhatsApp on your phone, reliable internet, laptop with Chrome



-- STRONG ADVANTAGE --

Experience managing 10+ properties simultaneously

Experience with AirCover claims, Airbnb Resolution Centre, or chargeback evidence

Experience with Turno or similar photo-verification cleaning software

Experience training or managing other VAs (we will scale and you may build a team under you)

UK market experience



-- COMPENSATION --

$720 USD per month for full-time (40 hours/week)

Paid monthly via Tap Tap Send

13th month bonus in December

30-day performance review

Clear growth path: as we scale toward 20+ properties, this role grows in pay and responsibility, potentially building and leading an operations team under you



-- HOW ONBOARDING WORKS --

Week 1: Watch the Loom training library, read the operations manual, meet the cleaning teams, shadow how we work. You learn before you act.

Week 2: You take on guest messaging and cleaning verification with the director reviewing your work daily.

Weeks 3-4: You take full ownership of daily operations. The director reviews your daily summary.

This is a 30-day paid trial. If we are both happy, this becomes a permanent senior role.



-- TO APPLY --

Answer ALL FOUR questions. Generic or copy-paste applications will be deleted unread.



1. A guest at our Brighton property messages at 10am: "there is mould in the bathroom, this is disgusting, I want a refund or I am leaving a 1-star review." Walk me through exactly what you do, who you contact, what you say to the guest, and in what order.



2. You check Turno after a checkout and the cleaner has uploaded no photos. The next guest checks in at 3pm. It is now 11am. Walk me through your exact next steps.



3. A guest checks out and you discover they have damaged a bed. Walk me through what you do to make sure we can actually recover the cost. Be specific about timing and evidence.



4. You are running 13 properties at once. Describe the actual system or daily routine you use to make sure nothing falls through the cracks. Tell me about a real system you have used before, not what you would do in theory.



In your first line, tell me the most properties you have managed at one time, and the channel manager you have used most.

This pays 2–3x what every comparable TikTok Shop role on OnlineJobs.ph offers. Keep reading to see why we can pay this and what we expect in return.





Essentially: you are building an entire TikTok Shop affiliate company from the ground up, with full financial backing and US LLC infrastructure provided by us. You bring the operational skill. We bring the capital, legal structure, and US-side resources.





About this role: 

This is not a typical VA role. This is a lead operator role for someone who wants to build a real TikTok Shop affiliate business and earn like a senior tea
mber with real upside, not a flat-rate VA.



We're a US-based holding company launching a TikTok Shop affiliate operation. We provide the infrastructure — US LLC, EIN, US bank account, US-resident device/IP setup, US shipping addresses, working capital, and TikTok Shop seller verification. You build and run the operation. Product research, account warming, scripts, content production, posting, optimization, scaling. When the time is right, you propose new hires and we approve, fund, and onboard them under our LLC — and you earn a cut of what they produce.



You're the operator on the ground. The owner is hands-on with strategy, sets all base pay, approves all hires and fires, and owns final say on direction. You drive execution day-to-day with real autonomy inside that framework.



If you've ever run a successful TikTok Shop account and thought "I should be doing this with a real company behind me instead of $2/hr for an agency" — this is that opportunity, with the US LLC infrastructure already solved.



What success looks like

Month 1: Two TikTok Shop accounts warmed and posting 5+ videos/day each, with first commission revenue landed

Month 3: Three accounts running, 10+ videos/day total, $3,000+/month in net profit, your share clearing $750/month on top of base

Month 6: Established daily playbook, $15,000+/month in net profit, your share at $3,750/month on top of base (total ~$5,250/month)

Month 12: Scaled operation with 1–2 helpers you've trained, $25,000+/month net profit possible, your share clearing $6,000+/month plus base plus year-end bonus



Day-to-day responsibilities

You own day-to-day execution. That includes:



Product research — daily Kalodata / Shoplus / FastMoss workflow, your own filter stack, daily shortlist of 10 candidates, scoring top-performing videos for replicability



Sample sourcing — submit free sample requests and refundable sample purchases via TikTok Shop Creator Center to our US shipping addresses



Content production — generate 5 script variants per winning product, brief US-based on-camera recorders with structured shot lists, edit raw clips in CapCut



UGC creator hiring — you can brief and hire US-based on-camera talent through 
 (you brief them, they record, you edit and post — they don't need to keep the product). Budget for this comes out of operating expenses, approved by us.



Account operations — stagger-post 5–15 videos/day across 2–3 TikTok accounts (each on its own isolated device/IP), tag every video's affiliate product from Showcase before publishing, manage comment moderation and account hygiene



Pre-followed account acquisition — purchasing TikTok Shop-eligible accounts (5,000+ followers) is a legitimate part of the playbook. You'll source candidate accounts and submit them for our approval before purchase.



Drop-off & hook analytics — pull swipe-away / retention curves from TikTok analytics on every video, identify exactly where viewers leave, and use that data to rebuild hooks that hold attention past the first 3 seconds



Performance management — track 24-hour and 72-hour performance per video in shared Google Sheets, flag winners and losers per decision rules you build (with our sign-off)



Team training (when we hire) — when we approve a new hire, you train them, oversee their daily output, and earn a percentage of their net production on top of your base and your own profit share



Must-haves

1+ year hands-on TikTok Shop affiliate experience (you've personally operated accounts, not just managed someone else's)



Working knowledge of Kalodata, Shoplus, or FastMoss — you can name the filter stack you'd use to find a trending product without us prompting



Hook analytics fluency — you regularly look at where viewers swipe away from your videos and use that data to rebuild hooks. You can explain a specific time you fixed a low-retention video by studying the drop-off curve.



Exceptional written English (your scripts go to US viewers; your briefs go to US recorders)



Proven ability to ship volume — 5+ videos/day, every workday, without quality drop



Data-driven mindset — you read GMV growth, commission rate, and affiliate count signals fast and act on them



2+ years remote work experience with verifiable OnlineJobs.ph or Upwork references



Proficient in Slack, ClickUp or Notion, Google Sheets, CapCut, ChatGPT



4+ hour overlap with US Mountain Time



Reliable computer, fast internet, backup power



Comfortable with daily WhatsApp check-ins (morning plan + end-of-day recap) and a weekly direction call



Operator mindset — you treat this like real work that compounds, not a 9-to-5



Nice-to-haves

Prior experience under a US-LLC-backed structure operating US-market TikTok Shop accounts

Experience editing UGC-style product review videos

Experience hiring and briefing UGC creators (HourlyUGC, Upwork, Billo, etc.)

Prior experience training and overseeing junior tea
mbers



Resources we provide

US LLC, EIN, US bank account, US shipping addresses, TikTok Shop seller verification

Working capital for samples, account purchases, and initial creator briefs

Tools budget: Kalodata, Shoplus or FastMoss, ChatGPT Plus, Claude Code, CapCut Pro, any other tool you make a case for

US-based UGC talent budget via HourlyUGC and similar platforms

Daily strategy access to the owner via WhatsApp, weekly direction call





Compensation

Base salary: $1,500/month ($8.66/hr × 40 hrs/week), paid weekly via Wise — your guaranteed floor



Personal profit share: 25% of monthly Net Profit you personally generate, paid monthly, uncapped, for as long as you are with the company



Net Profit definition: Gross affiliate commission revenue minus all operating costs, including your $1,500/month base salary, contractor pay (UGC creators, helpers), software subscriptions (Kalodata, CapCut, ChatGPT, Claude Code, etc.), sample purchases, account purchases, banking fees, and US LLC overhead. Your base is paid by the company as a normal expense — it does NOT come out of your 25% share.



Worked example (a $5,000 Net Profit month):



Gross affiliate commission revenue: $8,000

Less your base salary: ?$1,500

Less samples & account purchases: ?$500

Less software (Kalodata, CapCut, ChatGPT, Claude Code): ?$300

Less UGC creator contractor pay: ?$500

Less banking and LLC overhead: ?$200

= Net Profit: $5,000



Your 25% share: $1,250

Your total monthly comp: $1,500 base + $1,250 share = $2,750

Comp at higher Net Profit tiers (base always paid separately on top):

At $5,000/month Net Profit: $1,500 base + $1,250 share = $2,750/month total



At $15,000/month Net Profit: $1,500 base + $3,750 share = $5,250/month total



At $30,000/month Net Profit: $1,500 base + $7,500 share = $9,000/month total



Team override (when we hire helpers under you): When the company hires a helper under your direction, the helper's net production is split three ways:



Helper: 25% of their own net production (same share structure as yours)



You (operator override): 15% of the helper's net production, paid monthly alongside your personal profit share



Company: the remaining 60%



The 15% override equals 20% of the company's 75% cut — a meaningful piece of every helper you train and retain. The better you train them and the longer they stay productive, the larger your monthly override grows. Worked example: if a helper generates $5,000/month in net production, helper earns $1,250, you earn an additional $750 override on top of your own profit share, company keeps $3,000.



Year-end bonus: At fiscal year-end (December 31), you receive a bonus equal to 10% of the personal net profit you generated for the company during that fiscal year, paid by January 31.



Example: if your personal accounts generated $120,000 in net profit across the calendar year, your year-end bonus = $12,000, on top of all monthly profit shares already paid



This is designed to reward staying through the full year — someone who's accrued meaningful YTD profit has a real reason to finish the year strong rather than walk in November



Bonus applies only if you're with the company on December 31 of that year



Performance floor: After the first 3 months (during which we are getting the process / pipeline up and running): 

Your personal monthly net profit generation must clear your monthly base pay ($1,500). If you fall below base for 3 consecutive months OR any 4 months within a rolling 6-month window, the role is terminated unless we judge that exceptional extenuating circumstances apply (which we will weigh case by case).



Why this beats every comparable listing:

Typical TikTok Shop VA on OnlineJobs.ph: $800–1,500/month flat, no profit share, no bonus

Senior pod operator with commission: $1,500–2,000/month + 5% personal sales (~$1,750/month at our target revenue)

Most "profit share" listings: $2,000 base + 10?ove a high margin threshold (~$2,250/month at our target revenue)

This role at $15K/month personal net profit: $5,250/month + 15% override on any helpers you train (~$750/mo per $5K-producing helper) + year-end bonus accruing toward $12K+ — total annualized comp ceiling far above any flat-rate or pod role on this platform



Transparency: Net Profit is calculated from a Google Sheet you'll have read access to, updated daily. Every line item is visible. No black box.



How we work together

Daily WhatsApp check-ins. Each morning you send a short message with your plan for the day. Each evening you send a recap of what you completed. Takes 5 minutes total. This is non-negotiable.



Weekly direction call. One scheduled call per week (30–45 min) to discuss overall progress, priorities, and any decisions that need our sign-off.



Final decisions rest with us — all hiring, firing, base pay, account purchases, and revenue policy decisions default to the owner. You propose, recommend, build the case. We approve.



You have real autonomy inside that framework on day-to-day execution: content choices, hook iterations, posting cadence, niche pivots, product picks, contractor briefs.



Long-term mindset — the owner's other business has retained OnlineJobs.ph hires for 2+ years. We invest in operators who invest in us.



How to apply

Follow all application instructions below carefully.



In your application message, answer every question below, numbered, in order:



List every TikTok Shop affiliate account you've personally operated. Include handle and approximate monthly revenue at peak.



What product research tool do you use? Walk us through your exact filter stack — the specific filters, in order, that you'd apply right now to find a trending product worth promoting this week.



Describe one specific time you looked at a TikTok video's swipe-away curve, identified where viewers were dropping off, and rebuilt the hook to fix it. What did the original hook say, what did the data show, and what did you change it to?



Pick one TikTok Shop product you'd promote this week. Tell us (a) the product, (b) why you'd promote it (data-backed), and (c) the exact 3-second hook you'd open with.



Describe one independent operational decision you've made on a TikTok Shop account — what was the call, what was the data behind it, what was the outcome?



What's your current US Mountain Time overlap availability?



What tools are you currently paying for out of your own pocket?



Do you currently operate any personal TikTok Shop accounts? (Yes/No — full disclosure required if yes)





At the very end of your application, in the final line, type the word "Kalodata" so we know you read this entire post.



For applicants who do follow these instructions, we'll shortlist the strongest candidates for a paid 2-hour trial task ($16 paid via Wise), and then interview finalists directly with the owner.



We're hiring one person and we'd rather wait three weeks for the right one than three days for the wrong one.



If you've ever wanted to run a US-market TikTok Shop business with the LLC, banking, and infrastructure handled — this is your shot.

title: Remote Sales Closer (Via Zoom)
description:
SALES ENROLMENT CONSULTANT — BUSINESS ACCELERATOR

Driven Personal Trainers | Remote | 12 hrs/week to start | Immediate Start



---



About the Role



Driven Personal Trainers is an Australian PT placement and mentoring company with 100+ gym locations nationwide. We are growing fast and looking for a confident, results-driven Sales Enrolment Consultant to handle inbound discovery calls for our Business Accelerator Program.



The Business Accelerator is a 12-week founder-led coaching program for ambitious personal trainers who want to build a real, scalable PT business. Leads are generated and pre-qualified by our VA team — your job is to get on the call, understand the PT's situation, and close the enrolment.



This is a warm inbound role. You are not cold calling. Every person you speak to has already expressed interest and been pre-qualified before they hit your calendar.



---



What You Will Do



- Take 30-minute inbound discovery calls with pre-qualified personal trainers across Australia

- Review the pre-call questionnaire responses before each call so you are fully prepared

- Diagnose the PT's current situation, identify their pain points, and present the Business Accelerator as the solution

- Handle objections confidently and close enrolments on the call wherever possible

- Follow up with any undecided prospects within 24 hours using an approved follow-up sequence

- Log every call outcome in GoHighLevel (GHL) immediately after each call

- Send a daily summary to the founder covering calls taken, enrolments closed, and pipeline status

- Manage enrolled PTs during the 4-week pre-start window — welcome message, check-in, and start date confirmation



---



What We Are Looking For



- Proven experience in sales calls, closing, or phone-based consultation — this is non-negotiable

- Confident, warm, and natural communicator — you do not sound like you are reading a script

- Strong active listening skills — you ask great questions and use the PT's own words back to them

- Comfortable handling objections around price, timing, and uncertainty without being pushy

- Reliable and self-managed — you take calls, log outcomes, and follow up without being chased

- Familiarity with CRM tools — GoHighLevel experience is a bonus but not required

- Interest in the fitness or personal training industry is a plus but not essential



---



Role Details



- Role Title: Sales Enrolment Consultant — Business Accelerator

- Starting Hours: 12 hours per week (weeks 1–4)

- Hours Progression: Increases based on performance — full time from week 12 if targets met

- Base Rate: USD $7.00 per hour

- Commission: USD $25–$40 per enrolment (tiered)

- Call Volume: Up to 9 calls per week initially, scaling with growth

- Location: Fully remote — work from anywhere

- Start Date: Immediate



---



**Commission Structure**



Standard tier (1–5 enrolments/month): USD $25.00 per enrolment

Performance tier (6–10 enrolments/month): USD $35.00 per enrolment + USD $50.00 monthly bonus

Elite tier (11+ enrolments/month): USD $40.00 per enrolment + USD $150.00 monthly bonus



All enrolments in a month are paid at the tier rate once you hit that tier — not just the ones above the threshold. Commission is paid on confirmed and paid enrolments only.



---



Realistic Earnings



Starting (12 hrs/week, 2 enrolments/week): approx. USD $134/week — USD $536/month

Starting (12 hrs/week, 3 enrolments/week): approx. USD $159/week — USD $636/month

Full time (40 hrs/week, 5 enrolments/week): approx. USD $405/week — USD $1,620/month

Top performer (full time, elite tier + bonuses): USD $560+/week — USD $2,240+/month



Hours increase based on performance between weeks 4 and 12. Hitting close rate targets consistently is the fastest path to full time hours and maximum earning potential.



---



**How to Apply**



Please apply with a short cover note answering the following three questions:



1. Describe a sales call or closing experience you have had — what was the product, what was your close rate, and how did you handle objections?

2. What do you do when a prospect says the price is too high?

3. Have you used GoHighLevel or any other CRM before? If yes, which one?



---



**60-Second Video Script — Required With Every Application**



In addition to your cover note, you must submit a 60-second video of yourself delivering the following script out loud. Record yourself on your phone or computer — no editing required. We are not looking for production quality. We are listening for your voice, your confidence, your English clarity, and how naturally you handle the close.



Deliver this script:



"Hey [Prospect Name], thanks so much for jumping on the call today — really appreciate your time.



I had a look at your answers before we spoke and it sounds like you've been putting in the work — you've got clients, you're earning, but something's holding you back from getting to where you really want to be. Does that sound right?



[Pause — wait for response]



That's exactly what the Business Accelerator is built for. It's a 12-week program delivered directly by our founder — not a course, not a template. Real coaching, real systems, built around your specific situation as a personal trainer.



The investment is $149 a week for 12 weeks. The next cohort kicks off in four weeks which actually gives you a bit of time to get your head around it before we dive in.



Based on everything you've told me — how does that sit with you?"



Upload your video to Google Drive, Loom, or YouTube (unlisted) and include the link in your application. Applications without the video will not be considered.



We are looking for someone who is confident, honest, and genuinely motivated by results. If that is you, we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior Construction Bookkeeper / QuickBooks Online Specialist
description:
**Job Title: Senior Construction Bookkeeper / QuickBooks Online Specialist**



Rocky Mountain Landscaping is a U.S.-based commercial landscaping and irrigation contractor looking for a highly skilled construction bookkeeper with strong QuickBooks Online experience.



This is not an entry-level bookkeeping role. We need someone who already understands construction bookkeeping, job costing, draws, reconciliations, payroll, AP, AR, compliance documents, and financial reporting for a small construction company.



**Pay:** $15–$25/hr depending on experience

**Position:** Long-term remote position

**Schedule:** Part-time or full-time depending on experience and availability



**Responsibilities:**



* Manage bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online

* Handle construction job costing and project-based financial tracking

* Prepare and track construction draws, progress billings, and payment applications

* Manage accounts payable, vendor bills, subcontractor invoices, and payment tracking

* Manage accounts receivable, customer invoices, payments, and collections tracking

* Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, loans, and other accounts

* Organize receipts, bills, invoices, and supporting documents

* Assist with payroll processing and payroll-related records

* Prepare P&L reports, job profitability reports, and other financial reports

* Track compliance documents, W-9s, 1099 information, COIs, lien waivers, and related records

* Help clean up, organize, and improve existing bookkeeping processes

* Work with ownership and CPA/tax professionals as needed



**Requirements:**



* Construction bookkeeping, contractor bookkeeping, or job-cost accounting experience is required

* Strong QuickBooks Online experience is required

* Experience with U.S. bookkeeping or accounting

* Strong understanding of job costing, project costing, AP, AR, payroll support, reconciliations, and financial reports

* Experience with construction draws, progress billing, retainage, lien waivers, W-9s, 1099s, and compliance documents is strongly preferred

* Very strong attention to detail and accuracy

* Fluent in English with strong written communication skills

* Able to work independently and ask clear questions

* Trustworthy, organized, and comfortable handling confidential financial information



**Preferred Experience:**



* QuickBooks Online cleanup work

* Payroll support for construction or field employees

* Receipt management systems

* Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, OneDrive, SharePoint, or similar tools

* Experience working with small U.S. construction companies, contractors, trades, or project-based service businesses



**To Apply:**

Please include:



1. Your QuickBooks Online experience

2. Your construction bookkeeping or job-cost accounting experience

3. The types of construction or contractor companies you have worked with

4. Your experience with payroll, AP, AR, reconciliations, draws, and financial reporting

5. Your expected hourly rate

6. Your availability and preferred working hours



Start your application with “Senior Construction Bookkeeper” so we know you read the full post.

title: Data, Operations and Compliance Support Officer (AI-Enabled Back Office)
description:

title: Stock Options Trading Assistant
description:

• Place and manage limit orders, stop losses, and trailing stops

• Monitor positions and alerts during trading hours

• Adjust orders when instructed

• Maintain a simple trade log in Google Sheets or Excel

• Notify me of filled orders or unusual activity



Important:

You will not be responsible for d

• Basic understanding of stock trading

• Experience with options trading

• Familiarity with order types (limit, market, stop, trailing stop)

• Experience with Interactive Broker is a plus

• Strong attention to detail

• Reliable internet connection

• Ability to follow precise instructions

• Comfortable communicating quickly during market hours



Preferred

• Experience trading options

• Experience using trading platforms such as Interactive Broker, TradingView, ThinkorSwim, etc.

• Experience assisting traders or working in financial markets

• Basic spreadsheet skills (Excel / Google Sheets)



Work Schedule

Flexible, but availability during U.S. market hours is preferred.



Compensation

$1,000/month + bonus for high performance.



To Apply

1. Your experience with trading platforms

2. Whether you have used Interactive Broker before

title: E-Commerce Video Editor (Beauty Brand) – Strong AI Experience Required
description:
IMPORTANT: Please apply only if you can provide RELEVANT portfolio samples that demonstrate proven experience creating short-form direct-response ads. Generic editing portfolios will not be reviewed.



We’re looking for a full-time E-Commerce Video Editor with a strong eye for performance creative and paid social ads.

This role is for someone who understands more than timelines, transitions, and clean cuts. You need to know what makes people stop scrolling, keep watching, click, and buy.



You’ll be creating performance-focused video ads for platforms like Meta, TikTok, and YouTube. The ideal editor understands hooks, pacing, retention, product angles, buyer psychology, and ad structure. You should be comfortable working with UGC, product footage, testimonials, AI-generated assets, and performance data.



We’re looking for someone who can move fast, test ideas, improve creatives, and use AI tools to produce better ads at a higher volume.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Edit short-form e-commerce ads, including UGC, product demos, testimonials, comparison ads, and offer-based creatives.

2. Build attention-grabbing openings that make viewers stop within the first few seconds.

3. Add captions, graphics, transitions, sound design, and platform-native elements.

4. Work with media buyers and creative strategists to improve ads based on performance results.

5. Keep project files organized and easy to manage.

6. Use AI image and video tools to create additional ad assets.



AI & Creative Technology Requirements:



1. Create strong prompts for AI-generated video and image assets.

2. Have experience using tools such as Nanobanana, VEO3, HeyGen, Arcads, or similar platforms.

3. Produce AI-assisted UGC-style clips, product shots, and supporting B-roll.

4. Improve AI outputs through clear testing and prompt adjustments.

5. Blend AI-generated assets into polished, conversion-focused video ads.



Qualifications:



1. Experience editing e-commerce, paid social, or direct-response ads.

2. Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and sales-driven storytelling.

3. Knowledge of direct-response scripting, consumer psychology, and SEO.

4. Skilled in Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar editing software.

5. Familiarity with TikTok-style, Meta-first, and mobile-native ad formats.

6. Able to manage multiple projects and deliver on deadlines.

7. Strong eye for detail and ability to solve creative problems quickly.

8. Eager to learn new tools, formats, trends, and AI workflows.

9. Attention to detail check: include “DR. STRANGE” in your cover letter title or
 subject line.



Character & Mindset:



1. Focused on results and performance.

2. Self-driven and proactive.

3. Comfortable receiving feedback and making fast revisions.

4. Clear communicator and reliable team player.

5. Able to adapt quickly in a fast-moving environment.

6. Motivated to grow, improve, and keep leveling up.



How to Apply:



Please send:



1. Your CV or resume

2. Portfolio or reels showing short-form direct-response ads

3. A short video introduction

4. A brief note about your experience with AI video tools



We’re looking forward to hearing from editors who understand both creative quality and performance.

title: Landscape & Irrigation Designer / CAD Specialist
description:
**Job Title: Landscape & Irrigation Designer / CAD Specialist**



Rocky Mountain Landscaping is a U.S.-based commercial landscaping and irrigation contractor looking for an experienced Landscape & Irrigation Designer / CAD Specialist to help with commercial project design, drafting, and plan support.



This is a long-term remote position for someone who understands landscape plans, irrigation layouts, construction drawings, and commercial site plans.



**Pay:** Depends on experience

**Position:** Long-term remote position

**Schedule:** Part-time or full-time depending on availability



**Responsibilities:**



* Prepare and revise landscape and irrigation plans

* Create planting layouts, plant schedules, and material schedules

* Draft irrigation layouts, including heads, valves, controllers, mainlines, laterals, and zones

* Review civil, architectural, landscape, and irrigation plans

* Assist with irrigation design calculations, pipe sizing, zoning, and coverage review

* Prepare CAD drawings, markups, as-builts, and design revisions

* Help with quantity takeoffs for landscape, irrigation, hardscape, and sitework items

* Coordinate plan notes, details, schedules, and drawing updates

* Communicate clearly with our estimating and project teams



**Requirements:**



* Experience with landscape design, irrigation design, or construction drafting

* Strong AutoCAD experience

* Ability to read construction plans and site drawings

* Strong attention to detail

* Fluent in English with strong written communication skills

* Able to work independently and ask clear questions

* Reliable internet connection



**Preferred Experience:**



* Commercial landscape or irrigation design

* Irrigation hydraulics, zoning, pipe sizing, pressure loss, and head layout

* Landscape planting plans and plant schedules

* Land F/X, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Revit, SketchUp, Bluebeam, or similar software

* Experience with U.S. construction plans

* Experience with landscape, irrigation, hardscape, grading, or sitework projects

* ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI tools



This role does not require a U.S. landscape architect license, but strong landscape and irrigation design experience is important.



**To Apply:**

Please include:



1. Your landscape design and irrigation design experience

2. The software you use

3. Whether you have worked with U.S. construction plans

4. Your expected hourly rate

5. Your availability and preferred working hours

6. Sample work of landscape designs and irrigation designs, commercial properties only, not residential



Start your application with “Landscape Irrigation Designer” so we know you read the full post.

title: Quick Hire for VA Call Handling
description:
Important: Selected applicants will receive a response within 24 hours. Due to the volume of applications, we may move forward with other candidates if we do not receive a timely response.



We are currently hiring for a long-term Remote Receptionist position. Responsibilities include answering inbound calls, scheduling appointments, de-escalating complaints, and completing administrative tasks in a fast-paced environment. This is a performance-based role where all calls are recorded and regularly audited for quality assurance. 



For candidates who may be a stronger fit outside of a voice-based role, we also offer non-voice positions with a heavier focus on administrative tasks, subject to availability and overall fit.

(1) Where in the Philippines are you currently located? Which backup solutions do you currently have in place for internet or power interruptions?



(2) Please submit a screenshot of your internet speed and a few samples of your previous work output.  



(3) Please submit two short voice recordings. Recording one should demonstrate booking an appointment from 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM with a total amount of $60. Recording two should demonstrate handling a double charge for a 90-minute massage where the client sees two $90 charges and is requesting a refund. 



(4) Are you currently employed or engaged in any other work, business, freelance projects, or income-generating activities? If yes, please briefly describe your current commitments and typical weekly availability.

(8) What is the highest workload you have personally handled in a single day or in a single week? Please describe it using specific, measurable figures and briefly explain the context of that workload.



(9) Briefly introduce yourself and describe the qualities, experiences, work habits, or achievements you believe genuinely set you apart from other applicants for this role.

title: Architect
description:
We are seeking a licensed Architect or highly experienced architectural professional with a strong background in working with a California-based clients to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for producing precise elevations, coordinating MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) layouts, and ensuring that all measurements are meticulously verified. This position requires a deep understanding of construction documentation, interior architecture, and the ability to bridge the gap between conceptual design and technical execution. You will work during PST business hours and get paid weekly + HMO.



To prioritize your application, please complete the assessment: 



Qualifications



- Bachelor’s degree in Architecture (or related field) with 2-3 years of professional experience.



- Proven experience working directly with US-based architecture firms, developers, or clients (knowledge of US building standards, imperial units, and architectural workflows is required).



- Strong creative vision balanced with technical precision.



- Demonstrated ability to manage complex project workflows with high attention to detail.



Responsibilities



- Utilize existing SketchUp models to develop detailed architectural plans, elevations, and construction details. Verify all measurements for electrical, plumbing, and structural elements to ensure accuracy.



- Collaborate with US-based clients, vendors, and internal tea
mbers to interpret project goals, address client needs, and ensure design intent is maintained through the construction documentation phase.



- Prepare high-quality client presentations, including 3D mock-ups and renderings, to communicate design concepts effectively.



- Assist in preparing project quotes, ensuring adherence to the full project workflow from schematic design through to construction administration.



- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of industry standards, building technologies, and architectural best practices to ensure all deliverables meet professional standards.



- Handle project documentation, record-keeping, and vendor management to ensure seamless project delivery.



Please include a copy of your CV and portfolio or sample works.

title: Operations & Sales Manager
description:
Operations & Sales Manager — Aqua Home Supply

Remote | Philippines-Based | Full-Time Base: $1,500 USD/month + Uncapped Commission





About Aqua Home Supply

Aqua Home Supply is a fast-growing US-based e-commerce company specializing in water treatment products. We move fast, we take customer experience seriously, and we're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work and runs with it.





The Role

We're hiring an Operations & Sales Manager to own the day-to-day execution of our order fulfillment, vendor relationships, and customer operations. This is a critical role — you are the operational backbone of the business.



This is not a task-taker position. We need someone who identifies problems before they become fires, communicates proactively, follows through without reminders, and takes genuine pride in running a clean operation.



If that sounds like you, keep reading.





What You'll Own

Order Management & Fulfillment



Review the full order tracking queue daily — flag delays, contact vendors proactively, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks

Process approved orders accurately and on time

Manage open orders through to delivery confirmation (~150 orders/month)



Vendor Relations



All vendor communication runs through you — order status, delays, damage claims, cancellations, return authorizations, missing parts, and custom quotes

Build and maintain professional vendor relationships

Document every vendor interaction in the order record, same day



Customer Operations



Handle inbound sales inquiries under $4,000 — build quotes in Shopify and follow up via HubSpot

Manage escalated support tickets from our CS team via Zendesk

Respond to all direct customer
s within 24 hours

Ensure every customer is acknowledged before any ticket is escalated internally



Returns & Claims



Determine return eligibility, who covers shipping, and coordinate logistics

Request return authorizations from vendors and relay instructions to the CS team

Manage freight broker relationships for oversized returns

Track all open claims and follow up with vendors within 1–2 business days



Reporting & Admin



Prepare aged order summaries for weekly management review

Follow up on open HubSpot deals and unconverted quotes



Team Supervision



Daily check-in with our CS Reps — review the ticket backlog, flag stuck tickets, confirm nothing is sitting unaddressed

Give direct feedback to the CS Reps and escalate performance concerns when needed





What We're Looking For

Proven e-commerce or retail operations experience — you've managed orders, vendors, and customer issues before and you know what good looks like

Obsessive follow-through — things don't fall through the cracks on your watch

Detail orientation — you catch errors before they ship, not after

Proactive communication — you flag problems before deadlines, not after

Self-management — you don't need reminders to complete recurring tasks

Strong written English — you're communicating with US customers and vendors daily

Experience with Zendesk, Shopify, and/or HubSpot is a strong plus





What This Is Not

This role is not for someone who needs constant direction, waits to be asked before taking action, or lets aged issues sit without follow-up. We've built detailed SOPs and you'll have full support — but we need someone who executes independently and owns outcomes.





Compensation & Schedule

Base Salary: $1,500 USD/month

Commission: Earned on closed sales — uncapped. Top performers significantly exceed base pay.

Schedule: Full-time, aligned to US business hours

Location: Remote — Philippines-based candidates only





To Apply

Read these instructions carefully — they are part of the application process.



Subject Line: Your application must include the following subject line exactly as written: "AHS Ops — I Read Everything". Applications submitted without this exact subject line will be immediately discarded, no exceptions.



Your submission must include all three of the following:



Your CV/resume



A personalized video — record a short video (1-2 minutes) addressed specifically to Aqua Home Supply. Tell us who you are, what you know about our business, and why you believe you are the right fit for this role. Generic videos that could have been recorded for any company will not be considered. The video must mention Aqua Home Supply by name.



A written note — not a template, not a cover letter. A brief, specific paragraph telling us about an operational problem you personally identified and solved in a previous role. What was the problem, what did you do, and what was the outcome?



Applications missing any of these three elements will be discarded without review. We are looking for someone who follows instructions precisely and pays attention to detail — this process is the first test of exactly that.

title: Performance Video Editor
description:
**Performance Video Editor**



**Remote — Australia (Melbourne-based team) | Full-time, 38 hours/week AEST**



---



### **Not all editors make ads. The best ones make blinds look like the most exciting thing on the feed.**



We're 5 Minute Blinds. We sell custom-made blinds and curtains that Australians can measure, order, and install themselves in minutes, not weeks. We don't sell window coverings. We sell **taste**.



We're looking for a Performance Video Editor who can turn fabric, light, and transformation into scroll-stopping creative that actually drives sales.



---



### **About Us**



We're a Melbourne-based DTC brand reshaping how Australians buy window furnishings. Custom-made, expertly crafted right here in Australia, designed to be installed by anyone with a cordless drill.



We're growing fast across Meta, TikTok, Google, and Pinterest. Every room transformation, install demo, and fabric close-up is an opportunity to win a customer and we need an editor who treats it that way.



---



### **The Role**



This isn't a "make it look pretty" editing role. You'll sit at the intersection of creative and conversion, cutting video that stops thumbs mid-scroll, drives new customer acquisition and helps us achieve our mission of becoming the experts in the window furnishings industry.



You'll work directly with our performance marketing team, turning campaign data into creative decisions and shipping new ad variants at the pace performance media demands.



---



### **What You'll Actually Do**



- **Turn performance data into visual strategy** by working with the paid media team to understand what's converting (and what isn't), then design edits that double down on what works

- **Edit conversion-focused video** across Meta, TikTok, Reels, YouTube, Shorts, Pinterest, and Google optimised for each platform's aspect ratios, sound conventions, and viewer behaviour

- **Master the 3-second hook** - our products are visual, but the feed requires virality. You'll craft openings that earn the next 30 seconds

- **Rapidly iterate and A/B test** design concepts based on performance data and real-time campaign feedback

- **Design scroll-stopping videos and motion graphics** that capture attention within 3 seconds and drive engagement

- **Participate in creative reviews** to analyse top-performing creative elements and extract replicable design principles

- **Multiply creative output through AI tools** — Leverage cutting-edge AI Technologies to enhance asset generation and production efficiency

- **Meet performance benchmarks** including click-through rates, engagement rates, and conversion metrics across all campaigns

- **Deliver assets on deadline** while maintaining quality standards and organised documentation systems

    

    ---

    



### **What Sets You Apart**



- **Proven experience** — Minimum of 2-3 years in a similar role. You've got a strong grasp of design fundamentals and know your way around Adobe Creative Cloud.

- **You analyse data before designing** — You don't just want to know what looks good; you want to know what converts and why

- **You've mastered rapid iteration** — You can produce multiple high-quality variants quickly, not precious about your work

- **You understand the psychology behind conversions** — You know why certain visuals trigger action and how to implement those principles

- **You can translate performance metrics into design decisions** — CTR, Hook Rate & CVR aren't just acronyms to you; they're design briefs

- **You think like a growth marketer, not just a designer** — You care about business outcomes, not just aesthetics

- **You make decisions fast** — You're comfortable with speed, can manage multiple projects, and deliver quality under tight deadlines



---



### **Why Join Us**



- **Real ownership of a fast-growing brand** — your edits will be seen by hundreds of thousands of Australians every week, and you'll see the revenue impact in real time

- **Work with purpose, Ideas become reality** — Create assets that drive real business results. We celebrate bold work and strong concepts get implemented quickly.

- **Learn constantly** — Gain expertise across multiple platforms and industries. Receive honest input that drives improvement through open discussion.

- **Creative autonomy** — We'll give you the problem, not micromanage your process

- **Flexible work arrangements** — Fully remote with core hours for team collaboration. Focus on results, not desk time, with freedom to structure your day (with core collaboration hours).

- **Supportive team culture full of A-players** — Our rigorous hiring ensures everyone on the team is exceptional while ensuring we win as a team.

- **Performance-based rewards** — We recognise and compensate exceptional results

- **Growth opportunity, Collaborative environment** — Help shape our creative approach as we expand. Knowledge sharing without creative politics or egos.



---



### **Ready to Prove You're in the Top 1%?**



Our hiring process is built to identify exceptional talent — quickly.



1. Apply with your resume and a portfolio/reel of performance work (please link to the actual ads, not just brand films)

2. Shortlisted applicants complete a trial performance editing project using real 5 Minute Blinds footage & creative brief

3. Finalists join us for a portfolio review and creative strategy discussion



**Applications without the completed project will not be considered.** This is intentional we're hiring on output, not credentials.

title: Ecom Video Editor For Meta/TikTok Ads
description:
About Us:

We are a dynamic and rapidly growing 7-figure women's jewelry brand powered by Shopify. We are passionate about great design that speaks for itself, drawing inspiration from everyday fashion and influencers, and genuinely caring about the products we create and the relationships we build. Our marketing is performance-driven, and high-converting video creative is central to our scaling strategy.



The Role:

We're seeking a skilled and agile E-commerce Response Video Editor (full time / 40 hours per week) who understands how to create video ads that don't just look good but convert. You will work in lockstep with our Creative Strategist, taking raw footage (UGC, potentially studio shots) and briefs to produce engaging, platform-optimized video ads primarily for Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and TikTok. Your job is to execute rapidly, iterate effectively based on performance insights (provided by the strategist), and ensure the final output is engineered for maximum engagement and conversions. Forget long-form content; this is about short, punchy, direct-response video.



Key Responsibilities:



• Edit High-Performing Video Ads: Transform raw footage and strategist briefs into compelling video ads optimized for Meta and TikTok feeds/stories/reels.



• Rapid Iteration: Quickly execute multiple variations of winning ad concepts provided by the Creative Strategist (testing different hooks, visuals, text overlays, CTAs, music). Understand that iteration based on data is key.



• Platform Optimization: Expertly edit for platform best practices – strong hooks within the first 3 seconds, fast pacing, engaging captions/text overlays, appropriate aspect ratios (9:16, 1:1, 4:5), safe zones, and effective sound design.



• Integrate Copy & CTAs: Seamlessly weave in primary text concepts, headlines, and clear calls-to-action as guided by the strategist.



• Collaborate Closely: Maintain clear, fast communication (Slack, etc.) with the Creative Strategist to receive feedback, discuss edits, and ensure alignment with performance goals.



• Asset Management: Organize and manage video files and project assets efficiently.



• Meet Deadlines: Deliver high-quality edits reliably and on schedule in a fast-paced environment.



Who We're Looking For:



• Proven Social Ad Editing Experience: Minimum 2+ experience specifically editing short-form video advertisements for performance marketing campaigns on Meta & TikTok. A portfolio showcasing direct-response style video ads is required.



• Technical Proficiency: Highly skilled in video editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut is a major plus). Proficiency in basic motion graphics (e.g., After Effects for text overlays) is desirable.



• Platform Native: Deep understanding of what works visually on TikTok and Meta feeds/stories/reels – you know the trends, the hooks, the pacing, the sounds that grab attention immediately.



• Performance-Oriented Mindset: You understand the goal is conversion, not just aesthetics. You are receptive to feedback driven by ad metrics and can adapt edits accordingly. (Links to Strategist's "Data Mastery," "Creativity That Converts").



• Speed and Agility: Ability to work quickly, execute variations efficiently, and adapt to changing requirements without sacrificing quality. (Links to Strategist's "Adaptability & Agility").



• Collaborative Spirit: Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively and receive direction from a Creative Strategist. (Links to Strategist's "Collaboration is Key," "Clear Communication").



• Strong Work Ethic & Accountability: Reliable, proactive, meets deadlines, and takes ownership of edit quality – no babysitting needed. (Links to Strategist's "Work Ethic").



• Detail-Oriented: Ensures brand consistency, correct aspect ratios, and error-free text/graphics. Nothing sloppy makes the cut.



• Basic understanding of direct response marketing principles.



• Experience editing UGC content.



Compensation:

$1,000 base monthly salary, plus monthly performance-based bonus/incentives tied to creative contribution.



How to Apply:



In your proposal, please include:



1. Provide your Resume/CV and link to your portfolio showcasing performance-driven social video ads for Meta/TikTok.

2. Briefly describe your process for editing a typical 15-45 sec. video ad.

3. How do you handle feedback and rapid iteration requests from creative strategists?

4. List your primary editing software and mention your experience with CapCut.

5. What AI tools or software have you used to create video ads? Provide as much detail as possible and share any previous AI work if any.
