title: Transaction Coordinator & Client Experience Specialist
description:
Position Overview

Are you a master of organization who refuses to let any detail slip through the cracks, while simultaneously possessing the vibrant personality needed to make clients feel like celebrities?



Get House Ready LLC is seeking a multi-talented Transaction Coordinator & Client Experience Specialist. We are a high-volume, dual-licensed ecosystem combining residential real estate sales, mortgage loan origination, and automated credit score improvement into a unified client experience.



This is not a traditional, hidden-in-the-back transaction coordinator role. You are the ultimate air traffic controller for our files and the champion of our client experience. You will manage contract compliance from execution to settlement, coordinate seamlessly between our realtors, in-house mortgage processing team, and credit advocates, and actively surprise and delight our clients with white-glove concierge onboarding and social media highlights.



Key Responsibilities

1. Contract Management & Closing Execution

File Compliance: Manage real estate escrow transactions from contract execution to a successful, compliant settlement. Review purchase agreements, addenda, and disclosures for complete accuracy.



Team Synchronization: Serve as the central communication hub. Connect daily with our realtors, lending team, processing staff, title companies, and co-op agents to ensure absolute readiness for the closing table.



Timeline Enforcement: Track and enforce critical contract contingencies and mortgage milestones (appraisals, title commitments, loan commitments) to ensure our signature timelines are flawlessly met.



2. Concierge Services & World-Class Client Experience

Moving & Utility Setup: Act as a dedicated concierge for our buyers under contract, successfully enrolling them into various home utilities, moving resources, and vendor service programs.



Problem Resolution: Serve as the front-line advocate for clients experiencing friction during the contract window, resolving issues quickly with elite customer service and a calm, reassuring posture.



The "Win" Factory: Collaborate with our marketing staff by capturing and formatting real-time client milestones (e.g., getting clear-to-close, moving day) into exciting content to be celebrated on our social media channels.



Required Skills & Experience

Real Estate Literacy: 2+ years of direct experience as a licensed or unlicensed Transaction Coordinator, Real Estate Assistant, or Title Processor. You must thoroughly understand real estate contracts, terminology, and timelines.



Elite Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You must be able to command a file's timeline while speaking with title attorneys, realtors, lenders, and anxious first-time buyers alike.



Customer Service Obsession: A deep passion for hospitality and customer care. You don't just want to move paperwork; you want to create an unforgettable, stress-free journey for a family buying a home.



Tech-Savvy Adaptability: High proficiency with modern transactional management portals, digital signature platforms, and a strong comfort level using GoHighLevel CRM and publishing basic social media updates.



The "Glue" Mentality: Ability to take direct feedback from the CEO, collaborate smoothly within a multi-department team, and maintain complete independent ownership over your daily pipeline tasks.



Why Join Get House Ready LLC?

We operate a high-energy, automated, and rapidly growing business where your operational efficiency directly changes lives. If you love structure, hate messy files, and get energized by creating unforgettable client experiences, you belong on our team.

title: Social Media VA — Mining/FIFO UGC Sourcing & Creator Outreach
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're a Perth-based recruitment company in the Australian mining industry. We grow our brand by resharing the best viral and trending content about mining life, FIFO (fly-in fly-out) and DIDO (drive-in drive-out) work — always with the creator's permission and full credit — and using it to attract people who want to get into the industry.



We're looking for a sharp, online-savvy Social Media VA to keep a steady pipeline of this content flowing. You'll work during Australian Western Standard Time (AWST) business hours — the same as Philippine Standard Time.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Monitor TikTok, Instagram, YouTube,
, LinkedIn and Reddit for trending/viral content about the Australian mining industry and FIFO/DIDO life and roles

- Spot high-engagement posts early and track what's gaining traction

- Reach out to the original creator to request permission to (a) repost their content and (b) add our caption/call-to-action — professionally and on-brand

- ALWAYS credit and tag the original creator's handle on every repost, every time

- Repurpose approved content for our channels and add a clear call-to-action, e.g. "Interested in mining work or breaking into the industry? Reach out or visit our website."

- Keep written records of who was contacted, their response, and permission granted (in writing)

- Organize approved content into a library/spreadsheet with post links, creator handles, permission status, and usage notes



MUST-HAVE SKILLS

- Strong instinct for what's trending and shareable on social media

- Excellent written English with a friendly, persuasive outreach style

- Experience with creator / influencer / community outreach

- Highly organized — tracks every contact, credit, and permission carefully

- Comfortable across all major social platforms and basic content tools



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience running UGC, influencer, or repost-style campaigns

- Basic graphic/video editing to add captions and CTAs (Canva, CapCut)

- Any familiarity with mining, trades, FIFO work, or recruitment

- Social scheduling tools (Later, Buffer, Metricool)



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your message with the word "REPOST-READY" (applications without it are deleted).

2. Send me a link to ONE trending post about Australian mining or FIFO life you can find, PLUS the short message you'd actually send that creator to ask permission to repost it with our caption added.

3. Tell me which platforms you know best and any UGC or creator-outreach work you've done.



Strong applicants will hear back within a few days. Looking forward to seeing what you find!

Your mission is to profitably scale Aviora's customer acquisition through Meta paid social. You will own the full ad account — from campaign architecture and creative testing to budget management and performance reporting — ensuring we are consistently acquiring customers at or below target CAC while scaling spend efficiently.

ROAS: Campaign and account-level return on ad spend targets met consistently

Creative Velocity: New creative tests launched weekly — you move fast and keep the testing pipeline full

Spend Efficiency: Budget allocated and scaled in line with performance, no wasted spend sitting in underperforming ad sets





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Proven experience running and scaling Meta ad accounts for DTC or eCommerce brands — supplement or health/wellness experience is a strong plus

Demonstrated ability to scale budgets profitably — we want to see numbers, not just titles

Deep understanding of Meta campaign structure, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and creative testing methodology

Strong analytical instinct — you read data daily and make decisions from it, not gut feel

An autonomous operator who owns outcomes, communicates proactively, and doesn't need hand-holding

Up to date on iOS privacy changes, Meta's evolving algorithm, and how to navigate attribution in a post-cookie environment





WHY JOIN AVIORA



Performance-Based Rewards: Bonus structure tied directly to account performance — when the numbers hit, you share in the upside

You struggle when platform rules change overnight. Meta's ad ecosystem shifts constantly — policy updates, algorithm changes, creative fatigue — and you need to adapt without losing 
ntum.

This is not a role where we will teach you the STR industry. If you do not already know the platforms, workflows, and guest experience standards at a professional level, please do not apply.



PLATFORMS YOU MUST KNOW BEFORE APPLYING



Hostaway

PriceLabs

Airbnb

VRBO

Truvi

Safely



DAY-TO-DAY RESPONSIBILITIES



Manage all guest communication in Hostaway — pre-booking, check-in, stay, checkout, and post-stay review requests — with professional, on-brand messaging

Monitor and respond to Airbnb & VRBO inquiries within SLA targets; handle objections and special requests confidently

Oversee PriceLabs settings, review pricing recommendations, flag anomalies, and make or escalate rate adjustments

Manage owner/guest insurance and damage claims through Safely and/or Truvi

Coordinate housekeeping, maintenance, and restock jobs through Hostaway task workflows

Keep listings optimized — photos, descriptions, amenities, house rules — across all OTAs

Flag negative reviews proactively and draft management responses

Manage owner reporting and reservation summaries as needed

Identify operational issues before they become guest complaints



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE



Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience as a STR property manager, co-host, or STR VA

Must have directly managed Hostaway (inbox, calendar, automations, task assignments)

Must have used PriceLabs — not just heard of it, but actively managed dynamic pricing settings

Strong written English — guest messages must be warm, clear, and professional without editing

Available during US business hours (Central or Eastern preferred); availability for weekend monitoring required

Reliable internet (minimum 20 Mbps), backup connection preferred

Highly organized and detail-oriented — you will manage multiple properties simultaneously

Proactive communicator — you escalate issues before they become problems



APPLICATION SCREENING QUESTIONS



Answer all of the following in your application. Vague or generic answers will be disqualified.



1. How many months or years have you actively managed properties in Hostaway? Describe 2 specific tasks you perform in it regularly.



Why we ask: Rules out anyone who has only watched tutorials or used it briefly.



2. In PriceLabs, what is a Base Price Multiplier and when would you adjust it? What is a Min Stay override and why would you use one?



Why we ask: Anyone who truly uses PriceLabs can answer this immediately.



3. A guest messages at 10pm saying the WiFi is down and threatens a 1-star review. Write exactly how you would respond and what steps you would take.



Why we ask: Tests real guest communication skill and problem-solving under pressure.



4. Describe a specific mistake you made managing a STR property and how you handled it.



Why we ask: Anyone with real experience has made and learned from mistakes. Vague answers are a red flag.



5. What is your current availability in US Central or Eastern time? Are you available for weekend monitoring?



Why we ask: Non-negotiable operational requirement.



6. What is your internet speed and do you have a backup connection? (Paste a screenshot of a speed test if possible.)



Why we ask: Connectivity issues are a disqualifier for remote guest communication roles.



COMPENSATION & DETAILS



Full-time, long-term position — we are not looking for freelancers or part-time applicants

Competitive salary based on verified experience level

Performance bonus structure available after 90-day probationary period

Stable, growing company — we want someone who will grow with us



HOW TO APPLY



Send your resume and answer all 6 screening questions above in your application message. Applications missing answers to any screening question will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will receive a short practical skills test before any interview takes place.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

We're a small, fast-moving house of pet lifestyle brands — elevated, editorial accounts for cat and dog lovers, plus a creator course launching this fall. We treat our pets as family, and we talk up to our audience, never down. We're looking for one warm, sharp, genuinely likable person to be the daily voice of our brands in the comments and DMs.

This is an engagement role, not a posting role. Our team creates and schedules all the content. Your job is what happens after a post goes live — and in 2026, that's the single biggest driver of growth: fast, real, human engagement in the first hour.



WHAT YOU'LL DO EVERY DAY

Warm up the accounts before each post. In the ~15 minutes before our Reels go live, prime each account — reply to recent comments and leave a few genuine comments on accounts in our niche — so each post drops into an already-active feed. This pre-post warm-up is part of the daily rhythm, not optional.

Work the live window. The 
nt our Reels go live, you're there — replying to every comment and like, and starting real conversations across our Instagram and
 accounts. The first 60–90 minutes after each post is the priority.

Manage DMs across all accounts — answer questions, welcome new followers, route anything important to the manager.

Outbound engagement — genuinely engage in pet-focused communities and on creator accounts in our niche (thoughtful comments, not spam) to grow our presence.

Keep our voice — every reply sounds like the brand: warm, a little elevated, pets-as-family. We'll give you brand-voice tools that make this fast and consistent (full training provided).

Log your work daily via a simple Google Form.



THE SCHEDULE (please read before applying)



Our posts go live in the evening US time, which is morning your time. The core, non-negotiable window is:

7:45 AM – 10:30 AM Philippine time, 6 days a week — be online by ~7:45 AM to warm up the accounts before the first post. This is when content goes live, and engagement matters most.

Plus a short follow-up window later in your morning, and flexible hours for outbound, DMs, and planning.

If you can't reliably be online and engaging during that 7:45–10:30 AM PHT window six days a week, this role isn't the right fit — and that's okay.



HOW YOU'LL WORK



You'll work through Parsec on a company computer based in the US (we set this up and give you access). All engagement happens through that machine — never from your own phone or device. This protects our accounts and is strictly required.

You'll use our internal brand-voice reply tools to stay fast and on-brand. We do not allow outside AI content generators, and we screen applications for AI-written responses — please write to us in your own words.



You report to our Operations Manager — all day-to-day questions go to her.



PAY & LOGISTICS

$550–$650/month, paid biweekly via PayPal or Remitly (your choice). Invoices on the 15th and 1st, paid within two business days. Shortlisted applicants complete a short paid trial task before the final hire.



SCREENING QUESTIONS



Our posts go live in the US evening — that's 8:00–10:30 AM your time (PHT). Can you reliably be online and actively engaging during that window, six days a week? Please answer honestly.



Tell me about a brand or creator whose comment section/community engagement you admire — and what specifically makes it work.



In your own words: what's the difference between replying to comments and actually growing a community?



Quick voice sample — reply to this comment the way a warm, slightly-elevated pet brand would: "omg he is SO handsome, what breed is he??"



Are you comfortable working entirely inside our systems (Parsec on our US computer + our reply tools) and never engaging from your own device?

title: Virtual Assistant / Executive Right-Hand — Fast-Growing LA Auto Brokerage
description:
Virtual Assistant / Executive Right-Hand — Fast-Growing LA Auto Brokerage

Full-time | Remote | Long-term role for the right person

About Us

We're Apex Auto Leasing, a licensed auto brokerage based in Los Angeles. In plain English: we make buying and leasing cars easy. People come to us when they want a new lease, want to buy a specific car, or want to sell the one they have — and we handle everything. We find them the right car, negotiate the best price, and get it delivered to their door. We're growing fast and building a team, and I'm looking for one sharp, hungry person to become my right hand and help me scale.

About the Role

This is not a "do one small task" job. I'm looking for someone who can become my go-to person — someone I can hand things to and trust they'll get done right, without me babysitting. You'll touch almost every part of my day-to-day, but two areas matter most:

1. Finding leads (clients). Helping me find people who want to buy, lease, or sell a car — through research, online marketplaces, social media, and lead generation. You need to actually know how to do this.

2. Finding talent (salespeople). This is one of my biggest priorities. I'm building a team of salespeople, and I need help finding experienced people who already work at car dealerships. You'll research dealership websites and LinkedIn, build organized lists of salespeople with their contact info, and help me identify the ones most likely to be hungry and want a better opportunity. You'll help me draft and organize outreach (I approve everything before it goes out).

If you can consistently bring me good leads AND good potential hires, you become irreplaceable to me — and I'll take care of you for it.

What You'll Do Day-to-Day

Lead research & generation — finding potential car clients across online sources

Recruiting research — building lists of dealership salespeople (name, role, contact info, LinkedIn) and flagging the strongest candidates

Content & design in Canva — turning my car deals into clean social media posts, stories, and reels using my brand style

Social media management — scheduling and posting daily deals and content to Instagram (consistency is everything)

CRM & automation — entering and organizing leads, building and maintaining workflows

Vehicle research — looking up car specs, trims, and inventory when I'm working a deal

General assistant work — whatever helps me move faster

Quick note before you keep reading, because I only want people who actually read: when you apply, the very first word of your message must be the word APEX. I'm putting this instruction right here in the middle on purpose. If you skim job posts and skip to the bottom, you'll miss it — and if you miss it, your application gets deleted without a second look. I need someone with attention to detail, and this is how I find them.

Requirements (You Must Have These)

These are not "nice to haves." If you can't do these, please don't apply:

Excellent written AND spoken English. This is my single biggest requirement. You'll be writing messages, building lists I read every day, and possibly communicating on my behalf. Your English needs to be clean, professional, and natural-sounding. I will be testing for this directly, so don't apply if this isn't a real strength.

Strong Canva skills. You can design clean, professional graphics on your own without hand-holding.

Lead generation / online research ability. You know how to find people and information online that others can't.

Recruiting, sourcing, or list-building experience. You can build organized, accurate contact lists from scratch.

CRM & automation experience — GoHighLevel, 
, or similar tools. You can set these up and make them work, not just click around.

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and a self-starter. I'll give you direction, but I need someone who takes initiative — not someone I have to chase.

Hungry and reliable. I want someone who gives 110% every day and genuinely cares about doing great work. I'm building something big, and I want someone who grows with me.

Big Plus — This Could Make You My Top Pick

If you have experience in sales or the car/automotive industry, you move straight to the top of my list. Someone who understands selling and understands cars is exactly the kind of person I want next to me. If that's you, make sure I know it.

Bonus on top of that:

Appointment setting experience

Basic video editing for reels

Details

Schedule: Full-time, with working hours overlapping US Pacific Time (Los Angeles)

Pay: Competitive — and I reward results. The better you perform, the more this role and your pay grow.

Long-term: I'm not looking for someone temporary. I want to find one great person and build a long relationship.

How to Apply

I read every application that follows the instructions — and ignore the ones that don't. To be considered:

Follow the instruction I hid earlier in this post. (If you read the whole thing, you already know what to do.)

In a few sentences, tell me about a time you found something or someone online that other people couldn't — show me your research skills.

Send me 2 examples of Canva designs you've made.

Tell me whether you have any sales or car-industry experience.

Tell me which of my two priorities — finding leads or finding salespeople — you'd be stronger at, and why.

If you're sharp, you speak great English, and you actually want to grow with a business instead of just collecting a paycheck — I want to hear from you.

title: Content Editor & WordPress Publisher
description:
For this job, exceptional reading comprehension is the most important. You can spot awkward wording, contradictions, redundancies, missing context, and sentences that don't sound natural.

The web development and other skills can be taught and I have plenty of tutorials. But someone who speaks, reads and writes English well is very important. I don’t mean someone who uses Chat GPT to write everything. You will be reviewing content organized by AI so you can’t expect AI to fix it. You can use AI to assist you but if you’re not a good writer or reader yourself than Chat GPT won’t save you.

Your skills will increase over time and so will the work amount, quality and complexity. I will help you teach you what you need but you also need to put effort on your end to learn new things and always consult with AI using the resources I give you to see if there’s something you missed. 

SEO Content Editor (Remote, Full-Time)

I'm looking for a full-time SEO Content Editor to edit and publish AI-assisted articles for multiple clients across industries like legal, medical, engineering, and real estate.

The articles are already written. Your job is to read them, catch anything that feels off — an abrupt sentence, a word that doesn't fit, a paragraph that loses the reader — and fix it. Sometimes that's one word. Sometimes it's a sentence or two. Then you'll add internal and external links, find or generate images, and publish everything in WordPress. A typical article takes 10 to 45 minutes depending on length and complexity.

What You'll Be Doing

Read articles and make small but precise edits for flow, tone, and readability

Add internal links to relevant pages on the same site and external links to credible third-party sources

Source or generate images, optimize them for web, and add alt text and captions

Publish in WordPress with the correct title tag, meta description, author, and category

Submit URLs to Google Search Console and Bing for indexing

Requirements

Excellent reading comprehension and written English

Strong attention to detail

Comfortable with WordPress and AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini

Reliable, responsive, and able to work 10am–6pm MDT independently

Assessment

Read the following two sentences and spot the one redundancy with the second one and how you'd fix it.

Question 1:

Myocardial infarction, commonly known as a heart attack, occurs when blood flow to part of the heart is blocked. This blockage, which can be caused by a buildup of plaque in the arteries, is something that can result in serious damage to the heart muscle tissue if it is not treated promptly and in a timely manner.

Question 2:

 What's awkward about this paragraph?

The witness reviewed the report. The report was reviewed by the witness before the witness submitted the report.

Question 3:

Which sentence sounds more natural?

A:

The company provides electrical services for residential homes.

B:

The company provides residential electrical services.

You should record yourself doing these assessments with Loom, have the camera turned on and talk through the edits you’re making. Fluent English is a requirement.



Put strawberry in the subject line and use 2 AP to apply (no more no less). For your ideal rate, also put $8/hr. This is the starting salary with a $1 per year raise depending on performance. If you put more or less for the desired salary you won't be considered.



Free Homepage Design — Web Production Assistant

What you'll do:

You'll use a pre-built HTML template and AI tools to create custom homepage demos for leads and prospective clients. Each demo takes about 30–45 minutes once you're comfortable with the process.

Step-by-step process:

Receive a client lead with basic info (name, company, transcript, or CV)

Paste the client info and the template HTML into Claude — ask it to return the full updated HTML

Generate a logo using ChatGPT (if the client doesn't have one)

Find or generate all images (hero, services, FAQ, organization logos, expert photo) using ChatGPT or Unsplash

Replace the placeholder image files in the project folder with client-specific images (save files with the correct filenames so they auto-update)

Remove any background from the expert/person photo using Photoshop or Canva

Proofread the page — check for wrong pronouns, leftover text from other clients, or broken images

Do a quality assurance check using the Ask Gemini feature in Chrome

Take a full-page screenshot using the Awesome Screenshot Chrome extension

Save the screenshot as [ClientName]-[Company]-[Expertise]-website-demo and send it over

Tools you'll use:

VS Code (to view/edit the HTML file)

Claude (to generate updated HTML content)

ChatGPT (to generate images and logos)

Unsplash (for stock photography)

Photoshop or Canva (to remove image backgrounds)

Google Chrome + Awesome Screenshot extension (for the final screenshot)

What to watch for:

Wrong pronouns (especially when the AI assumes gender from a name)

Broken or missing images

Text left over from a previous client's demo

No coding experience required — the process is mostly file management, AI prompting, and attention to detail.

Assessments

You need the full html but Claude only returned the text content. What do you prompt to get the full HTML? (Shouldn’t be more than 7 words.)

You download an image from Unsplash which is a jpg but you need a png. What do you do? Hint: you can change the extension simply by updating the name. (this one requires a quick Loom video. It should take 5 seconds)





WordPress Website Tasks

I'll train you on everything you need to know, and I provide tutorial videos walking through each task step by step. Your job is to watch those videos carefully and execute the process accurately. If you can follow a process and pay attention to detail, you'll do great here.

What you'll be doing:

Updating client websites using my custom WordPress theme hosted on Cloudways

Swapping out images, text, and page content based on the video walkthroughs I provide

Following a repeatable process for each client deliverable

Taking full page screenshots and sending completed work to me for review

Doing a quality assurance check on each page to catch things like wrong pronouns, broken images, or leftover text from a previous client

What I'm looking for:

Basic familiarity with WordPress (you understand the dashboard, how pages and posts work)

Someone who can watch a tutorial video and replicate the steps without needing hand-holding

Strong attention to detail

Reliable, communicates clearly, and asks questions when stuck rather than guessing

Nice to have:

Experience with Cloudways or any managed WordPress hosting

Familiarity with image editing tools like Canva or Photoshop

You can't have another job while working here. This has to be your full-time job and you have to be very responsive throughout the day through Google Chat. Not listening to the notification is not an excuse.



When you’re first hired, the first two weeks will still be more of a probationary period. If it doesn’t seem like you’re learning and producing work efficiently then this might not be the position for you.

You are obsessively organized — you do not miss deadlines, you do not forget tasks, and you proactively flag problems before they become Dr. Javaid’s problem

You understand social media deeply — you know the difference between an Instagram Reel and a carousel, why TikTok needs different captions than Instagram, and why YouTube titles need to be searchable

You are proactive not reactive — you do not wait to be told what to do next. You know the plan, you follow it, and you flag anything that is off

You take brand seriously — you understand that Dr. Javaid’s brand is built on clinical authority and bold personal narrative, and you protect that voice in every caption you write

You have a strong design eye — you can build clean, on-brand assets in Canva and turn complex clinical topics into clear, professional visuals without hand-holding

You are comfortable with health and medical content — you are not squeamish about topics like menopause, sexual health, hormones, and women’s bodies

You have worked with a personal brand or public figure before — you understand the sensitivity and discretion that comes with managing someone’s public presence

This role is NOT right for you if:

You need constant supervision or daily check-ins to stay on task

Your written English requires heavy editing before it is publishable

You treat social media as just a scheduling job — this role requires genuine understanding of what makes content perform

You are not available during overlap hours with US Eastern or Central time

06  |  AVAILABILITY & COMMUNICATION

20 hours per week — part-time with potential to grow

Must be available for a 30-minute weekly check-in call with Dr. Javaid or her team — Tuesday mornings US Central time preferred

Must respond to messages within 4 hours during your working day

Must be available same-day for urgent requests — a viral post or breaking news 
nt may require fast action

Weekly deliverable: content queue submitted for approval every Wednesday morning without exception

?  Time zone: Philippines, Latin America, or Eastern Europe preferred for overlap with US Central time. Please state your time zone clearly in your application.

07  |  COMPENSATION

Starting rate: Competitive and commensurate with experience. Please state your expected monthly rate in your application.

Hours: 20 hours per week with potential to grow as the brand scales.

Trial period: All candidates complete a paid trial project before a full-time offer is made. Trial compensation is $75 USD. Full details of the trial project are in Section 08.

Growth: This role has significant growth potential. Dr. Javaid is actively building toward a book launch, a TikTok Shop, and expanded keynote business. The right person grows with the brand.

08  |  THE TRIAL PROJECT

All shortlisted candidates complete this paid trial before a hiring decision is made. This is how we find the right person — not by resume, but by actual work.

Compensation: $75 USD upon completion

Timeline: 48 hours from assignment to submission

TRIAL TASK 1 — Content Packaging & Handoff Brief

Using the sample assets and weekly schedule provided, outline exactly how you would prepare one full week of content for Dr. Javaid across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube and hand it to the PR team ready to publish. For each piece include: platform, content type, what you would adapt per platform (captions, overlays, format), and how you would package and deliver it so nothing is missed. Then, in a few sentences, describe how you would keep her calendar and inbox in order during a heavy filming week.

TRIAL TASK 2 — Caption Writing

Write Instagram and TikTok captions for the following post:

Dr. Javaid is posting a 45-second Reel where she looks directly to camera and says: “Did you know PCOS was just renamed? Your doctor probably hasn’t told you yet. The new name is PMOS — Polyendocrine Metabolic Ovarian Syndrome. This isn’t just a name change. It’s a reclassification that could change how millions of women are diagnosed and treated. I have this condition. I was dismissed by doctors. Even as a physician. Here’s what you need to know.” End of video.

Write: (a) an Instagram caption with appropriate hashtags, and (b) a TikTok caption with appropriate hashtags. Both should match Dr. Javaid’s brand voice — bold, clinical, personal, and direct.

TRIAL TASK 3 — Podcast Show Notes

Write show notes for a fictional podcast episode using this brief:

Episode title: Why Your Doctor Never Warned You About Menopause. Guest: None — solo episode. Dr. Javaid covers: what perimenopause is and when it starts, why HRT has been misrepresented, what estrogen does for your heart, and what women should be asking their doctors right now. Episode length: 45 minutes.

Write SEO-optimized show notes of approximately 200–250 words including: episode summary, key topics covered, and a CTA to follow Dr. Javaid on Instagram and subscribe to her
 list.

?  Submissions that demonstrate genuine understanding of Dr. Javaid’s brand voice will be prioritized over technically correct but generic work. Read her Instagram captions 
 before writing.

09  |  HOW TO APPLY

To be considered for this role, your application must include all of the following. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.

A brief introduction — who you are, where you are based, and your time zone

Your relevant experience — specifically with social content editing, podcast administration,
 marketing, design of branded assets (e.g. media kits, educational materials), and executive support (calendar and inbox management). Name the tools you have used.

Two examples of captions you have written for a personal brand or public figure — include the platform and the account if possible

Your expected monthly rate for part-time work (20 hours/week)

Your availability for the trial project — can you complete it within 48 hours of receiving it?

Answer this question in 3–5 sentences: Dr. Javaid posts a Reel on Tuesday that gets 50,000 views in the first 12 hours — 10x her normal reach. What do you do next?

?  Applications that do not answer question 6 will not be reviewed. This question tells us more about how you think than anything else in your application.

Applications that stand out lead with specific experience, demonstrate knowledge of Dr. Javaid’s content and brand, and answer every question directly without filler.

WHAT THIS ROLE ACTUALLY IS

This is not a basic VA role.

This is an opportunity to be the operational backbone of one of the most important voices in women’s healthcare — at the exact 
nt that voice is breaking through.

The right person will grow with this brand.

The right person will be proud of the work they are part of.

The right person already knows who Dr. Somi Javaid is.

description:
Latest Free Stuff is one of the UK’s largest money-saving websites, helping millions of people discover free samples, competitions, giveaways, and money-saving opportunities. We’ve been featured on BBC Dragons’ Den and reach over 1 million monthly visitors through our website,
 newsletters, app, and social channels.



We’re looking for a talented Short-Form Video Editor to help us create engaging content for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



This is a long-term opportunity with significant room for growth and responsibility.





THE ROLE

You should be comfortable using both traditional editing software and modern AI tools to create high-quality content efficiently.

 Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

* Organise project files and meet deadlines.



AI-Powered Editing



* Use AI video editing tools to improve editing speed and quality.

* Use AI voice generation tools to create narration and voiceovers where appropriate.

* Use AI tools to generate captions, scripts, visual assets, and audio.

* Research and test new AI tools that improve editing workflows.

* Help automate repetitive editing tasks where possible.



Publishing Support



* Upload completed videos to TikTok, Instagram,
, and YouTube.

* Write titles, captions, and descriptions.

* Create thumbnails.

* Ensure videos are correctly formatted for each platform.

* Schedule content according to publishing instructions.



REQUIREMENTS



* Proven video editing experience.

* Strong portfolio of TikTok, Reels, or Shorts content.

* Experience with CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar software.

* Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, CapCut AI, ElevenLabs, Descript, Runway, Veo, HeyGen, Synthesia, or similar.

* Comfortable creating AI-generated voiceovers and audio content.

* Strong understanding of short-form content and audience retention.

* Excellent English comprehension.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Ability to work independently.

* Reliable internet connection and computer.





NICE TO HAVE



* Motion graphics experience.

* Thumbnail creation experience.

* Experience creating content for consumer brands.

* Familiarity with affiliate marketing, e-commerce, competitions, freebies, or digital media.





SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE



After 90 days, you will:



* Consistently create high-quality short-form videos.

* Deliver content with minimal revisions.

* Understand our preferred editing style and audience.

* Produce content efficiently using AI-assisted workflows.

* Help increase the volume and quality of content published each week.





COMPENSATION



Please include your expected monthly salary in your application.



This is a long-term position with opportunities for increased responsibility and compensation based on performance.



TO APPLY



1) Send your CV.

2) Send 3 examples of your BEST short-form video edits. Please include links and explain what parts of the editing you completed yourself.



3) Complete the Editing Test

Please create a short-form video (30–60 seconds) based on the following article:



Title of article - Ultimate List Of Free Birthday Stuff for 2026

Link to article - 



The objective is to create a highly engaging video suitable for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



Imagine your goal is to maximise:

* Views

* Watch time

* Likes

* Comments

* Shares

* Followers



We are deliberately providing minimal instructions because we want to see your creativity, judgement, editing ability, use of AI tools, and understanding of what makes engaging short-form content.



You may use:



* AI tools

* AI voiceovers

* Stock footage

* Motion graphics

* Music

* Sound effects

* Screenshots

* Animations

* Any editing software you prefer



Please submit:

* Any video format (MP4 file, AVI, MOV etc) 

* Please upload to a Google drive, OneDrive etc (please make sure the file is public) 



4) Final question 

How many 30–60 second short-form videos can you realistically create in a typical 8-hour working day while maintaining quality?



Please submit your application with:



* CV

* Portfolio links

* Expected monthly salary

* A Google Drive or OneDrive folder containing your completed editing test

* Answer to the productivity question



Please include the word “PINEAPPLE” in your application so we know you’ve read the full job description.
